body.faq_title: Partnership questions before you book a demo
body.faq_description: Clear answers about websites, domains, copy, Arabic content, billing, and what IGENTX delivers versus what Clayox covers alone.

faqs.question: What is the IGENTX Childcare Digital Partnership?
faqs.answer: It is IGENTX's done-for-you digital foundation for childcare centres, paired with Clayox. From Starter upward you get a template website, hosting, SSL, a 24/7 AI enquiry assistant, professional email, and SEO support. Clayox remains the operations platform. IGENTX delivers the public digital layer around it.

faqs.question: Who is this for?
faqs.answer: UAE childcare centres first, then centres across the GCC, that want Clayox plus a centre website, enquiry assistant, email, and SEO without assembling those pieces themselves. Preschools, nurseries, daycares, and early learning centres are all in scope.

faqs.question: How does billing work?
faqs.answer: Plans are billed annually in USD. We show the annual amount prominently and a monthly equivalent for comparison only. There is no self-serve payment gateway checkout on igentx.com or clayox.com. Book a Clayox demo to discuss your centre.

faqs.question: Does every plan include Clayox?
faqs.answer: Yes. Standalone includes Clayox for 20 students. Starter, Plus, and Growth each include Clayox for 25 students. Extra students are $0.99 per student per month, billed annually.

faqs.question: Can our team edit the website ourselves?
faqs.answer: No. Partnership websites are static. Clients cannot edit them directly. IGENTX makes changes within your plan's monthly maintenance hours. Extra changes outside those hours are paid work.

faqs.question: Who writes the website copy and provides images?
faqs.answer: IGENTX writes the website copy for your centre to review and helps with AI-generated graphics. Your centre shares its real photos for use on the site.

faqs.question: Is Arabic content included?
faqs.answer: Arabic website content is included on Growth only. Lower tiers are English unless you upgrade or add custom work.

faqs.question: Is a domain included?
faqs.answer: No. Design and hosting are included from Starter upward. Centres start on a free subdomain such as centrename.clayox.com. If you want your own domain, your centre buys and pays for it; IGENTX manages DNS and connection once you provide it.

faqs.question: Is the AI enquiry assistant part of Clayox alone?
faqs.answer: No. The 24/7 AI enquiry assistant is part of the partnership from Starter and up. Clayox itself includes AI translation and Write with AI for enrolled families and staff. Enquiry chats are reviewed by your team; lead conversion into the pipeline is manual, not automatic.

faqs.question: Do website maintenance hours roll over?
faqs.answer: No. Plus includes 1 hour per month and Growth includes 3 hours per month. Unused hours do not roll over to the next month.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee search rankings?
faqs.answer: No. Partnership SEO and GEO support help set up and maintain digital foundations. We do not promise rankings, traffic outcomes, or placement guarantees.

faqs.question: Where can I see the Clayox software-side details?
faqs.answer: Review the Clayox digital partnership page at https://www.clayox.com/digital-partnership for the software-side framing, then book a demo at https://www.clayox.com/contact.

body.title: Book a Clayox demo to map the right plan
